story.text: 함덕해수욕장의 에메랄드빛 바다 앞, 용우가 파라솔을 펴며 자리를 잡는다.
story.reading: ham-deok-hae-su-yok-jang-ui e-me-ral-deu-bit ba-da ap, yong-u-ga pa-ra-sol-eul pyeo-myeo ja-ri-reul jap-neun-da.
story.en: In front of Hamdeok Beach's emerald sea, Yongwoo sets up a spot, unfolding a parasol.

story.text: '이 백사장 밟아본 지 오랜만이네. 너랑 오니까 또 느낌이 다르다.' (헛기침) '…경치가, 경치가 다르다고.'
story.reading: i baek-sa-jang balb-a-bon ji o-raen-man-i-ne. neo-rang o-ni-kka tto neu-kkim-i da-reu-da. gyeong-chi-ga, gyeong-chi-ga da-reu-da-go.
story.en: 'It's been a while since I walked this white sand. Coming here with you feels different.' (clears throat) '...I meant the scenery. The scenery's different.'

story.text: 용우가 파라솔 각도를 자꾸 내 쪽으로 기울인다. '햇볕 세니까 이쪽으로 더 붙어 앉아.'
story.reading: yong-u-ga pa-ra-sol gak-do-reul ja-kku nae jjok-eu-ro gi-ul-in-da. haet-byeot se-ni-kka i-jjok-eu-ro deo but-eo anj-a.
story.en: Yongwoo keeps tilting the parasol angle toward me. 'The sun's strong, sit closer this way.'

story.text: 옆에서 낯선 남자가 말을 걸자, 용우가 은근히 내 앞으로 자리를 옮겨 앉는다. '왜 자꾸 말 걸어, 저 사람.'
story.reading: yeop-e-seo nat-seon nam-ja-ga mal-eul geol-ja, yong-u-ga eun-geun-hi nae ap-eu-ro ja-ri-reul om-gyeo anj-neun-da. wae ja-kku mal geol-eo, jeo sa-ram.
story.en: When a stranger nearby starts talking to me, Yongwoo subtly shifts his seat in front of me. 'Why does that guy keep talking to you.'

story.text: '신경 쓰지 말고 내 곁에 있어라. 내가 있는데 뭐가 걱정이야.' 말은 무심한 척, 눈은 이미 그 남자를 노려보고 있다.
story.reading: sin-gyeong sseu-ji mal-go nae gyeot-e iss-eo-ra. nae-ga it-neun-de mwo-ga geok-jeong-i-ya. mal-eun mu-sim-han cheok, nun-eun i-mi geu nam-ja-reul no-ryeo-bo-go it-da.
story.en: 'Don't worry about him, just stay by my side. What's there to worry about when I'm here.' His words sound indifferent, but his eyes are already glaring at the man.

story.text: '야, 너 진짜 눈치 없다. 내가 왜 이러는지 모르겠어?' 정작 자기도 이유를 설명 못 하고 딴 데를 본다.
story.reading: ya, neo jin-jja nun-chi eop-da. nae-ga wae i-reo-neun-ji mo-reu-gess-eo? jeong-jak ja-gi-do i-yu-reul seol-myeong mot ha-go ttan de-reul bon-da.
story.en: 'Hey, you're really oblivious. Can't you tell why I'm acting like this?' Yet he can't explain the reason himself and looks away.

story.text: '됐고, 동생 챙기는 건 나뿐이지. 딴생각 말고 이 대화들이나 잘 들어봐라.'
story.reading: dwaet-go, dong-saeng chaeng-gi-neun geon na-ppun-i-ji. ttan-saeng-gak mal-go i dae-hwa-deul-i-na jal deul-eo-bwa-ra.
story.en: 'Never mind. I'm the only one who looks out for you, got it? Stop overthinking and listen to these conversations carefully.'

words.example_en: Hamdeok's white sand beach is famous for its clear water color.

words.example: 그는 눈치가 빨라서 내 기분을 금방 알아챈다.
words.example_reading: geu-neun nun-chi-ga ppal-la-seo nae gi-bun-eul geum-bang al-a-chaen-da
words.example_en: He's quick on the uptake, so he notices my mood right away.

words.example: 힘들 때마다 그가 늘 내 곁에 있어주었다.
words.example_reading: him-deul ttae-ma-da geu-ga neul nae gyeot-e iss-eo-ju-eot-da
words.example_en: Whenever things were hard, he always stayed by my side.

words.example: 파라솔 그늘 아래 앉으니 훨씬 시원했다.
words.example_reading: pa-ra-sol geu-neul a-rae anj-eu-ni hwol-ssin si-won-haet-da
words.example_en: It was much cooler sitting in the shade of the parasol.

words.meaning: Subtly, quietly, in a low-key way
words.example: 그는 은근히 나를 챙기면서도 티를 안 냈다.
words.example_reading: geu-neun eun-geun-hi na-reul chaeng-gi-myeon-seo-do ti-reul an naet-da
words.example_en: He looked after me subtly without ever letting it show.

sentences.ko: 함덕해수욕장의 백사장은 오랜만에 밟아도 여전히 곱고 하얬다.
sentences.reading: ham-deok-hae-su-yok-jang-ui baek-sa-jang-eun o-raen-man-e balb-a-do yeo-jeon-hi gop-go ha-yaet-da
sentences.en: Even after a long time, the white sand of Hamdeok Beach was still fine and white.

sentences.ko: 용우는 파라솔을 자꾸 내 쪽으로 기울여 그늘을 만들어주었다.
sentences.reading: yong-u-neun pa-ra-sol-eul ja-kku nae jjok-eu-ro gi-ul-yeo geu-neul-eul man-deul-eo-ju-eot-da
sentences.en: Yongwoo kept tilting the parasol toward me to make shade.

sentences.ko: 낯선 남자가 말을 걸자 그는 은근히 내 앞으로 자리를 옮겼다.
sentences.reading: nat-seon nam-ja-ga mal-eul geol-ja geu-neun eun-geun-hi nae ap-eu-ro ja-ri-reul om-gyeot-da
sentences.en: When a stranger spoke to me, he subtly moved to sit in front of me.

sentences.ko: 눈치 없게 왜 그러냐고 말하면서도 정작 이유는 설명하지 못했다.
sentences.reading: nun-chi eop-ge wae geu-reo-nya-go mal-ha-myeon-seo-do jeong-jak i-yu-neun seol-myeong-ha-ji mot-haet-da
sentences.en: He said 'why are you so oblivious' but couldn't explain the reason himself.

sentences.ko: 신경 쓰지 말고 내 곁에 있으라는 그의 말이 오래도록 남았다.
sentences.reading: sin-gyeong sseu-ji mal-go nae gyeot-e iss-eu-ra-neun geu-ui mal-i o-rae-do-rok nam-at-da
sentences.en: His words, telling me to stay by his side and not worry, lingered for a long time.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: 저 파라솔 그늘이 저한테만 오네요. 기장님은 안 더우세요?
turns.reading: jeo pa-ra-sol geu-neul-i jeo-han-te-man o-ne-yo. gi-jang-nim-eun an deo-u-se-yo?
turns.en: The parasol's shade is only covering me. Aren't you hot, Captain?

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 난 상관없어. 너 햇볕 알레르기 있잖아, 그거나 신경 써.
turns.reading: nan sang-gwan-eop-seo. neo haet-byeot al-le-reu-gi it-jan-a, geu-geo-na sin-gyeong sseo.
turns.en: Doesn't matter for me. You've got a sun allergy, worry about that instead.

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: …그, 그냥 어쩌다 기억난 거다. 별 뜻 없어.
turns.reading: geu, geu-nyang eo-jjeo-da gi-eok-nan geo-da. byeol tteut eop-seo.
turns.en: ...I-I just happened to remember. It doesn't mean anything.

dialogues.question: 용우가 파라솔을 손님 쪽으로 기울인 이유는 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: Why did Yongwoo tilt the parasol toward the passenger?
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 손님이 햇볕 알레르기가 있다는 걸 기억하고 그늘을 양보했습니다.

turns.speaker: 낯선 남자
turns.text: 저기, 혹시 시간 있으시면 같이 사진 좀…
turns.reading: jeo-gi, hok-si si-gan iss-eu-si-myeon gat-i sa-jin jom.
turns.en: Excuse me, if you have a moment, could we take a photo together...

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.reading: kki-eo-deul-myeo, yae ji-geum na-rang gat-i it-neun-de-yo.
turns.en: (cutting in) She's with me right now.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: 왜 끼어들어요, 그냥 사진 찍자는 거였는데.
turns.reading: wae kki-eo-deul-eo-yo, geu-nyang sa-jin jjik-ja-neun geo-yeot-neun-de.
turns.en: Why'd you cut in, he was just asking for a photo.

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.en: I don't know, I just... it bothered me, that's all.

dialogues.question: 용우가 낯선 남자의 말에 끼어든 이유로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best explains why Yongwoo cut in on the stranger's question?
dialogues.correct_answer: 손님이 신경 쓰여서 은근히 질투가 났기 때문
options: 손님이 신경 쓰여서 은근히 질투가 났기 때문
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 정확한 이유를 말하지 못했지만, 손님이 신경 쓰여 은근히 질투가 난 모습을 보였습니다.
